title: SIOP RANDOMET 2017
official: Randomized multi-centre open-label non-inferiority phase 3 clinical trial for patients with a stage IV childhood renal tumour comparing upfront Vincristine, Actinomycin-D and Doxorubicin (VAD, standard arm) with upfront Vincristine, Carboplatin and Etoposide (VCE, experimental arm)
summary: Main objective: To determine non-inferiority of preoperative 6 weeks of VCE to VAD in the overall metastatic rapid response rate (MetRR) in newly diagnosed stage 4 childhood renal tumours. The MetRR will include the pulmonary response rate (PRR) and the response rate on non-pulmonary metastasis (NPRR).
conditions:
Stage IV childhood renal tumour with pulmonary +/- non-pulmonary
metastasis

interventions.name: Vincristine Sulfate 1 mg/ml Solution for Injection or Infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age <18 years >3 months
2. Patient suffering from metastatic renal tumour at initial diagnosis having at least one circumscript, non-calcified (pulmonary) nodule (or other lesion highly suspicious of metastasis according to criteria for metastatic disease) ≥3 mm as determined by chest CT-scan and abdominal CT-scan/MRI. Metastatic disease must be confirmed by central review.
3. Understand and voluntarily provide permission (subjects and when applicable, parental/legal representative(s)) to the ICF prior to conducting any study related assessments/procedures
4. Able to adhere to the study visit schedule and other protocol requirements
5. No pre-existing and ongoing cardiac malfunction disease
6. No pre-existing and ongoing liver function deficiency which is not controllable by substitution
7. Metastatic childhood renal tumour must be confirmed by central review.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patient and/or parental/legal representative(s) denied randomization
2. pre-existing health impairment that significantly hazards the safe treatment according to the study
3. unwillingness to follow adequate supportive measures including transfusion of blood products if medically needed
4. inability to receive chemotherapy according to the protocol, this is particulary true for: a. acute kidney failure needing dialysis treatment b. pre-existing peripheral neuropathy
5. Active, uncontrolled life threatening Infection (e.g. Acute Hepatitis, Pneumonia, AIDS, Varizella)
6. known chromosomal instability/susceptibility (e.g. Fanconi Anemia, Nijmegen Breakage Syndrome)
7. participation in other interventional trials (registration in observational noninterventional studies is acceptable)
8. age at start of treatment <3 months or >18 years
9. any other medical condition incompatible with the protocol treatment
10. primary nephrectomy
11. inability to be followed until two years after treatment
12. other chemotherapy prior to enrolment
13. other histology than nephroblastoma at diagnosis
14. Pregnancy or lactating
15. Fertile female with child bearing potential and fertile male subjects who deny the use of highly effective contraceptive measures
16. Treated by any investigational agent in a clinical study within previous 4 weeks
17. Hypersensitivity to the active substances or other excipients contained in the investigational medical products listed in the summary of product characteristics (SmPC) or Investigators Brochure (IB).
